MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Suicide Squad (Extended Cut) felt worth a try because its irreverent humor connects with what appealed to me about Blockers.",
    "That connection was enough for tentative interest, though it did not make the film a strong match overall."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Aquaman's superhero adventure did not appeal to me just because Suicide Squad's humor did; the humorous tone was the deciding factor.",
    "Military science fiction, disaster movies, and a serious legal thriller do not fit my current interest in something funny.",
    "I could not judge the unnamed items, so skipping them reflects uncertainty rather than a dislike of their content."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The selection seemed to assume that interest in one entertaining film would extend to action and spectacle more broadly.",
    "It treated very different viewing moods as interchangeable, although comedy, serious suspense, and disaster stories appeal to me for different reasons."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The irreverent humor connecting Blockers and Suicide Squad mattered more to my choice than superhero or action elements.",
    "Most of my recent titles are unknown here, so they provide little basis for claiming I have broad preferences across these kinds of films."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The selection caught a possible interest in irreverent humor but stretched it into an interest in action and dramatic spectacle that I do not feel right now."
}
